prompts.text: Describe every event in this clip, in order, with start and end times in seconds.
From when to when is the main subject moving across the frame?
How many distinct people, animals or vehicles appear? List them.
Describe the camera motion: static, pan, tilt, zoom or handheld?
How many scene changes are there, and at which timestamps?
List the objects in the foreground and the objects in the background.
Is any on-screen text, logo or caption visible? Quote it exactly if so.
Summarise this clip in one sentence for a video search index.
What happens first and what happens last? Answer in two short sentences.
Describe the dominant colours and the lighting conditions.
Where does this take place: indoors or outdoors, natural or built, day or night?
Give the time range of the single most visually salient action.
Is anything unusual, damaged, unsafe or out of place? Describe it or say none.
Describe the first visible frame, then the last visible frame.
Is this footage portrait, landscape or square, and is it rotated?
Describe the smallest detail you can reliably identify and when it is visible.
